First public **alpha** of Rootweft (Python package version `0.1.0a1`).

Rootweft builds a deterministic, evidence-backed structural knowledge graph of
Python, JavaScript and TypeScript repositories — offline by default — and
exposes it through a CLI, a read-only MCP server, a portable Agent Skill and a
self-contained HTML viewer.

## Install

```bash
pipx install "rootweft[mcp] @ git+https://github.com/edodelo/rootweft@v0.1.0-alpha"
# or download the wheel below, check it with SHA256SUMS, then:
pip install "./rootweft-0.1.0a1-py3-none-any.whl[mcp]"
```

Python 3.11–3.13 on Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Status and limitations

- **Alpha.** The graph schema (`rootweft.graph.v1`) and CLI may change before 1.0.
- **Jev adjudication is contract-tested, not live-verified.** The live Jev
  smoke test was **not** run for this release. Remote results are review-only
  proposals; there is no automatic promotion policy or decision cache.
- Cross-file call resolution is deliberately conservative.
- Harness support is limited to the checks recorded in
  [docs/HARNESS_COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/edodelo/rootweft/blob/v0.1.0-alpha/docs/HARNESS_COMPATIBILITY.md)
  (MCP handshake verified with Claude Code 2.1.280, Gemini CLI 0.60.0 and
  Hermes Agent 0.19.0; Codex CLI configuration-only).

## Assets

- `rootweft-0.1.0a1-py3-none-any.whl` and `rootweft-0.1.0a1.tar.gz`
- `rootweft-0.1.0-alpha.cdx.json` — CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM
- `SHA256SUMS` — verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`
- GitHub build-provenance attestations for the wheel and sdist
  (`gh attestation verify <file> --repo edodelo/rootweft`)
